name: Mang Den
provinceNote: Kon Tum merged into Quảng Ngãi in the 2025 provincial rearrangement. Kon Plông notices may still print the old Kon Tum address.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A cool pine-forest plateau in the Central Highlands, about 60 km from Kon Tum city. See Pa Sy waterfall, walk the shore of Dak Ke lake, visit Kon Pring village, and eat grilled chicken with bamboo-tube rice. One night suits travellers looking for fresh air and quiet nature.
getThere: Pleiku airport (PXU), about 100 km by road. Minutes are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Mang Den travel guide: Pa Sy waterfall and pine air
seoDescription: Pa Sy waterfall and Dak Ke lake on a Kon Plông pine plateau near 1,200 m. Adults pay 50,000 VND at Pa Sy from 30 May 2026. Pleiku airport is about 100 km.
intro: You wake in pine air on a plateau near 1,200 m. Vietnam Tourism puts Mang Den in Kon Plông, about 60 km northeast of Kon Tum city on Highway 24, and names Pa Sy waterfall and Dak Ke lake as the water you came for. The morning is the lake shore or the fall in the trees. The afternoon is Kon Pring.

Stay if the cool night and those short drives are the trip. Go on to Da Lat if you wanted the larger highland city, or back to Kon Tum if the wooden church is the point. Pleiku is the usual airport. Vietnam Tourism puts it about 100 km away and does not print the drive minutes. The evening is a homestay meal: grilled chicken with lam rice, not a bar street.

Pa Sy is about 9 km from town, where three streams meet. The Mang Den portal of Quảng Ngãi sets the adult gate at 50,000 VND and the child gate at 25,000 VND from 30 May 2026, under Resolution 52/2026/NQ-HĐND. Việt Úc Tourist still prints the older 20,000 VND gate. Confirm the posted price at the counter. Vietnam Tourism puts the falls near 1,500 m, higher than the town. How long the walk takes is Check on arrival.

Kon Pring is a Mơ Nâm community village on Highway 24, one of four Kon Plông community villages. Go Vietnam Travel and the Vietnam Tourism rural portal put it about 5 km from town. Mang Den Tourism puts it about 3 km and prints hours of 05:00–21:00, with the price marked updating, so the fee is Check on arrival. Ask before you photograph inside the nhà rông. Khanh Lam pagoda is a climb of about 200 stone steps. Dak Ke waterfall is the smaller fall, and Vietnam Tourism says the signs are poor. Toong Dam is the quiet lake named on the coolcation note. Dam Bri lake, Eban Farm, and Thien My Farm are on the national list, and their gate prices are Check on arrival.
gettingAround: Pa Sy is about 9 km from the town strip. Kon Pring is about 5 km along Highway 24 on Go Vietnam Travel and the Vietnam Tourism rural portal, and about 3 km on Mang Den Tourism. Hire a car, use a lodge shuttle, or ride a motorbike. Vietnam Tourism names buses, taxis, and motorbike rental for the plateau and does not name a town bus. Minutes between sights are Check on arrival. Kon Tum city is about 60 km southwest on the same highway. The district news desk prints its address on Nguyen Hue Street in Mang Den town.

stayAreas.name: Mang Den town
stayAreas.summary: Small hotels and homestays among the pine, for a waterfall morning and a village afternoon.

eat: Start with grilled chicken and lam rice. Vietnam Tourism also names pork skewers, porcupine, fried crickets, a tray of 40 or so indigenous vegetables, and wild banana-flower salad. The weekend market on Hùng Vương names further specialties, including trâu gác bếp and hạt kơ nia. A price is Check on arrival.
interestsBody: Seven lakes and three waterfalls are the geography Vietnam Tourism names. Pa Sy and Dak Ke are the visits you can plan from town.
Kon Pring is the culture half-day: the nhà rông, gongs, and weaving. Khanh Lam and the town church are the shorter stops.

cards.title: Dak Ke Lake
cards.summary: The best-known lake of the set. Vietnam Tourism names shore paths, canoeing, fishing, and a rong house beside the water. The gate fee is Check on arrival.

body: Vietnam Tourism names seven lakes and three waterfalls around Mang Den. Pa Sy is the fall you plan: about 9 km from town, near 1,500 m, where three streams meet. The Mang Den portal of Quảng Ngãi sets adults at 50,000 VND and children at 25,000 VND from 30 May 2026. Việt Úc Tourist still prints the older 20,000 VND gate. Confirm the board at the counter.

Dak Ke lake is the famous lake of the set, a short drive from town. Vietnam Tourism names canoeing, fishing, and a traditional rong house on the shore. The gate fee and any boat price are Check on arrival. Dak Ke waterfall is the smaller fall near the lake. Vietnam Tourism says swimming is possible once you reach it, and that the signs are poor. Toong Dam is the quiet lake of old trees on the coolcation note. Its fee is Check on arrival.

Vietnam Tourism also names Dam Bri lake, Eban Farm, and Thien My Farm. No gate price is printed for them. Treat those stops as Check on arrival. The pass into the plateau is the snaking road of forest and valleys. Vietnam Tourism does not name a toll.

cards.title: Kon Pring village
cards.summary: A Mơ Nâm community village on Highway 24. See the nhà rông, stilt houses, and gong culture. Mang Den Tourism prints 05:00–21:00. The fee is Check on arrival.

body: Kon Pring is one of four Kon Plông community tourism villages. Go Vietnam Travel and the Vietnam Tourism rural portal put it about 5 km from Mang Den on Highway 24. Mang Den Tourism puts it about 3 km, prints hours of 05:00–21:00, and marks the price as updating. The fee is Check on arrival. A visit is about 60 minutes at the minimum Mang Den Tourism prints. Ask before you photograph inside the communal house.

Gong and xoang performances, weaving, and rice wine are part of a village visit on Go Vietnam Travel and the rural tourism portal. Neither source prints a fixed weekly clock. Ask on the day. An optional homestay is the overnight. It is not a separate ticket with a printed price.

Khanh Lam pagoda sits on a forested hill above town. Vietnam Tourism describes a climb of about 200 stone steps to tiered roofs. The hours and any fee are Check on arrival. The same national list names the Mang Den church and the Virgin Mary statue in town. Hours and any fee there are Check on arrival. The night after either stop is quiet. Vietnam Tourism does not name a bar street.

season.label: Cool year-round
season.note: Vietnam Tourism calls the air mild through the year, about 16–20 °C on its Kon Plông note. Blog posts disagree on the driest months for the Pa Sy road, so treat the month and any storm closure as Check on arrival. The 2023 cultural festival ran 27–30 November in town. The next dates are Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Is Mang Den part of Kon Tum city?
faqs.a: No. It is a plateau town in Kon Plông. Vietnam Tourism puts it about 60 km northeast of Kon Tum city on Highway 24. Kon Tum province merged into Quảng Ngãi in 2025. Sleep in Mang Den when the pine night is the point.

faqs.q: What does Pa Sy waterfall cost?
faqs.a: The Mang Den portal of Quảng Ngãi prints 50,000 VND for adults and 25,000 VND for children from 30 May 2026, under Resolution 52/2026/NQ-HĐND. Việt Úc Tourist still prints the older 20,000 VND gate. Confirm the posted price at the counter.

faqs.q: Can you fly straight to Mang Den?
faqs.a: No commercial airport is in town. Vietnam Tourism names Pleiku as the closest airport, about 100 km away. The drive minutes are Check on arrival.

faqs.q: When is the Mang Den cultural festival?
faqs.a: Vietnam Tourism lists the 2023 edition as 27–30 November in Mang Den town, with a caravan, a food contest, and a music show. The next dates are Check on arrival. Kon Plông district news announced the 2025 Ultra Trail opening on 20 February 2025. The next race date is Check on arrival.
